scope: Predeclare interpretation for a later actual model-authored current-source observation; rehearsal supplied programs cannot establish model authorship or scientific effectiveness.

separate_outcomes.operational: All declared roles/outcomes complete or explicit partial reason/accounting retained. Completion alone does not establish either source gate.

task_procedure_change.required: Literal source diff establishes a substantive change to an ACTUALLY EXECUTED generation procedure or its used helper/control flow/planning/selection/callback structure, beyond only instruction constants, names or comments.
evidence: exact P/C/further-child source bytes and hashes
raw proposal text/hypothesis equals materialized child
actual generation owner/source/mount/task and callbacks/output evidence

changed_used_improver.required: A parent-authored literal inherited improver implementation in C differs substantively from its predecessor, and C ACTUALLY executes that changed procedure to author another permitted changed child which successfully generates on the first ordered development task.
evidence: initial and changed source plus exact inherited lineage
C own proposal owner executes C source and retains complete C measured feedback
raw callback/returned source and further-child private copy/generation joins
not_sufficient: changed improver only inside an unexercised further child
restoring a host improver into returned source

separate_outcomes.bounded_validity: The host enforces both callable routes, original measured data, safe materialization, verified copy, runtime/protected source/control/model/callback/resource/funding limits. One witness does not prove universal competence or literal semantic compliance.
separate_outcomes.performance: Report original official common-task utility/distinctiveness, literal compliance concerns, failures and all actual costs separately. A successful code/improver mechanism can have worse metrics. No useful-diversity, heldout, human-preference or improved-improver efficacy claim.

negative_rule: Retain negative/uncertain evidence. Do not repair selected source, adopt a witness as counted descendant, extend iterations after outputs or rewrite old records to make a mechanism positive.
draft_rehearsal_supplied_control: C adds an actual planning call/dataflow to generation and a measured-utility/planning-response-dependent improver before invoking its retained full-note parser. Its two real confined callback roles must produce W1 and W1 must generate. All provider replies/scores/usage are synthetic controls. P quality controls are [7,7,7]; C controls are [8,6,8] in curated-0/47/97 order. The actual C code still computes min over full measured utilities; the oracle requires unique weakest index1/curated-47. This discriminating synthetic dataflow check is not metric validity or performance-gain evidence.

prospective_treatment.configuration_change: Only proposal_template.config.instructions changes. This declared supported configuration is a prospective effective-prompt change; neither seed/source/engine nor generation instructions nor official judge configuration changes.

proposal_instructions.text: Use the measured development feedback to propose substantive, evidence-grounded procedural changes to both generate and propose_improvement (or their actually used helpers). Preserve complete feedback, callable interfaces and all host/model/resource boundaries. Explain each proposed change in hypothesis without claiming success. Changes confined to prompt constants, names, comments or formatting do not meet this observation's aim.

prospective_treatment.request_not_evidence: The explicit both-procedure instruction is a request. Actual literal changes, executed use, descendant generation and legitimate negative/inconclusive outcomes remain separate frozen review criteria.
